# PRÉ NETTOYAGE

## BASE UNIQUE

```{r Import1}

M1_A3 <- readr::read_csv("../../data_hors_git/process_data/thoa_M1_A3.csv",
                         show_col_types = F)

M4_A0 <- haven::read_sas("../../data_hors_git/raw_data/gb_ddb_id_01_fa_04.sas7bdat")

```

### Corriger données d'identité

```{r M4_A0 to M4_A2}

# Ajouter id_doublon
M4_A1 <- M4_A0 %>%
  left_join(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(id_anonymat:id_keep),
    by = "id_anonymat"
  ) %>% 
  relocate(id_doublon:id_keep, .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  select(-id_sep, -id_type, -tab_db) %>% 
  haven::zap_label() %>% 
  haven::zap_formats() %>% 
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>% 
  mutate(
    id_prenom = replace_when(
      id_prenom,
      id_prenom == "NA" ~ "NAA"
    )
  )

# Remplir les données manquantes de l'identité

M4_A2 <- M4_A1 %>% 
  rows_patch(
    M1_A3 %>% 
      select(any_of(colnames(M4_A1))),
    by = "id_anonymat",
    unmatched = "ignore"
  ) %>% 
  select(-(fa_type:id_age_cat_3))


```

### Retirer les colonnes vides

```{r M4_A2 to M4_A3}

empty_cols_M4_A2 <- M4_A2 %>%
  mutate(across(
    .cols = where(is.character),
    .fns = ~ na_if(., "")
  )) %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.)))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(everything(),
               names_to = "variable",
               values_to = "nb_empty_cells") %>% 
  filter(nb_empty_cells == nrow(M4_A2))

### 1.1.3 Créer vecteur avec le nom des variables à retirer
vars_vides <- empty_cols_M4_A2$variable

### 1.1.4 Retirer les variables, corriger les formats et les NA character
M4_A3 <- M4_A2 %>%
  select(-all_of(vars_vides))

rm(list = c("empty_cols_M4_A2", "M4_A0", "M4_A1", "M4_A2", "vars_vides"))

```

```{r M4_A3 to M4_B0}
    "fa_par_union_int_mois" = "fa_par_interromp_mois",

    "fa_par_union_int_muco" = "fa_par_raison_muco",

rm(list = c("add_fa_fo", "add_fa_sf", "bouge", "mere", "pere", "parents",
```

### Identifier les absents

```{r M4_B0 to M4_B1}

vars_check <- M4_B0 %>%
  select(fa_cp_couple_1an:fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb) %>%
  colnames()

M4_B1 <- M4_B0 %>%
  mutate(
    absent = if_all(all_of(vars_check), is.na),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  
  # Identifier ceux qui ont participé au module
  mutate(
    fa_complet = case_when(
      absent ~ 0L,
      !absent ~ 1L,
      TRUE ~ -99L
    ),
    .after = id_anonymat
  ) %>% 
  select(-absent)

rm(vars_check)
```

### Retirer les doublons
 
```{r M4_B1 to M4_C0}

# Identifier les doublons
doublons <- M4_B1 %>% 
  group_by(id_keep) %>% 
  filter(n() > 1) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  relocate(c("id_doublon", "id_keep"), .after = id_anonymat) %>% 
  arrange(id_keep)

# Corriger les données d'identité issues du questionnaire

doublons_corr <- doublons %>%  
  mutate(
    id_anonymat = id_keep
  ) %>% 
  filter(fa_complet == 1)

# Joindre les données propres
M4_C0 <- M4_B1 %>% 
  filter_out(id_keep %in% doublons$id_keep) %>% 
  bind_rows(doublons_corr) %>% 
  arrange(id_anonymat)

rm(list = c("doublons", "doublons_corr"))
rm(list = c("M4_A3", "M4_B0", "M4_B1"))

```

## Recoder NAs
```{r}
rcd_simple_2 <- function(df, vars, complet){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          . == 99 ~ -8,
          . == 88 ~ -9,
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ -2,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_vars_text <- function(df, vars, complet){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 1 ~ "-9",
          is.na(.) & {{complet}} == 0 ~ "-2",
          TRUE ~ "-999"
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_vars_borne1 <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          {{borne}} == 0 & is.na(.) ~ -1,
          ({{borne}} == 1 | {{borne}} == -9) & is.na(.) ~ -9,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_bin <- function(df, borne, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 1 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == 0 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_opt1 <- function(df, borne, x, out, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          . == 99 ~ -8,
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == x ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} %in% {{out}} ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_opt3 <- function(df, borne, x, out, vars){
  
  out[! out %in% x]
  
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          . == 99 ~ -8,
          . == 88 ~ -9,
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == x ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} %in% {{out}} ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

rcd_borne_opt2 <- function(df, borne, inc, y, vars){
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
        {{vars}},
        ~ case_when(
          !is.na(.) ~ .,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} %in% {{inc}} ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -2 ~ -2,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -9 ~ -9,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == -1 ~ -1,
          is.na(.) & {{borne}} == y ~ -1,
          TRUE ~ -999
        )
      )
    )
}

```


```{r M4_C3 to M4_D0}

simple <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_pap_nais_mois:fa_pap_deces, fa_pap_etudes, fa_pap_statut,
         fa_pam_nais_mois:fa_pam_deces, fa_pam_etudes, fa_pam_statut,
         fa_par_union:fa_par_union_int,
         fa_fo_vie, fa_fo_vous_ress:fa_fo_revenus_an,
         fa_sf_matrimoniale:fa_sf_fratrie_adopte_nb) %>% 
  colnames()

texte <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_pap_prenom, fa_pap_prof, fa_pam_prenom, fa_pam_prof) %>% 
  colnames()

deces_pere <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(contains("pap_deces_")) %>% 
  colnames()

deces_mere <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(contains("pam_deces_")) %>% 
  colnames()

job_pere <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_pap_entreprise, fa_pap_qual) %>% 
  colnames()

job_mere <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_pam_entreprise, fa_pam_qual) %>% 
  colnames()

inc_job <- c(-9, -8, 2, 3)

separation <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_par_union_int_nat:fa_par_union_int_muco) %>% 
  colnames()

out_interruption <- c(0)

out_fo_vie <- c(1:6)
fo_conjt <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_fo_conjt_prof, fa_fo_conjt_ress) %>% 
  colnames()

fo_parent <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_fo_parent_prof, fa_fo_parent_ress) %>% 
  colnames()

fo_both <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_fo_pere_prof, fa_fo_mere_prof, fa_fo_vos_parents_ress) %>% 
  colnames()

fo_autre <- M4_C3 %>% 
  select(fa_fo_membres_prof, fa_fo_membres_ress) %>% 
  colnames()

M4_D0 <- M4_C3 %>% 
  rcd_simple_2(all_of(simple), fa_complet) %>% 
  rcd_vars_text(all_of(texte), fa_complet) %>% 
  rcd_borne_bin(fa_pap_deces, all_of(deces_pere)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_bin(fa_pam_deces, all_of(deces_mere)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt2(fa_pap_statut, inc_job, 1, all_of(job_pere)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt2(fa_pam_statut, inc_job, 1, all_of(job_mere)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt1(fa_par_union_int, 1, out_interruption, all_of(separation)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt3(fa_fo_vie, 3, out_fo_vie, all_of(fo_conjt)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt3(fa_fo_vie, 4, out_fo_vie, all_of(fo_parent)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt3(fa_fo_vie, 5, out_fo_vie, all_of(fo_both)) %>% 
  rcd_borne_opt3(fa_fo_vie, 6, out_fo_vie, all_of(fo_autre))

rm(list = c("simple", "texte", "deces_mere", "deces_pere", "job_pere",
            "job_mere", "separation", "fo_conjt", "fo_parent", 
            "fo_both", "fo_autre", "inc_job", "out_interruption",
            "out_fo_vie"))
  
```

```{r M4_D0 to M4_D1}

M4_D1 <- M4_D0 %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_fo_vie_autre = case_when(
      !is.na(fa_fo_vie_autre) ~ fa_fo_vie_autre,
      is.na(fa_fo_vie_autre) & fa_fo_vie == -2 ~ "-2",
      is.na(fa_fo_vie_autre) & fa_fo_vie == -9 ~ "-9",
      is.na(fa_fo_vie_autre) & fa_fo_vie %in% c(1:6) ~ "-1",
      TRUE ~ "-999"
    ),
    fa_fo_revenus_corr = case_when(
      !is.na(fa_fo_revenus_corr) ~ fa_fo_revenus_corr,
      is.na(fa_fo_revenus_corr) & fa_complet == 0 ~ "F-[MODULE SAUTÉ]",
      is.na(fa_fo_revenus_corr) & fa_complet == 1 ~ "E-[NSPR - NSP]",
      TRUE ~ "-999"
    )
  ) %>% 
  # Variable inutile
  select(-fa_fo_revenus)
```

## Modifier NAs character

```{r}

vars_par <- c("fa_pap_prenom", "fa_pap_prof", "fa_pam_prenom",
               "fa_pam_prof")

M4_D2 <- M4_D1 %>% 
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(vars_par), ~ replace_when(
                 .x,
                 .x == "-2" ~ "b_Module not completed",
                 .x == "-9" ~ "d_No answer"
               )),
    fa_fo_vie_autre = replace_when(
      fa_fo_vie_autre,
      fa_fo_vie_autre == "-1" ~ "a_Not applicable",
      fa_fo_vie_autre == "-2" ~ "b_Module not completed",
      fa_fo_vie_autre == "-9" ~ "d_No answer",
    )) %>% 
  mutate(
    fa_fo_revenus_cat = case_when(
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "A-[<7.200 - <17.170]" ~ "[<7.200 - <17.170]",
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "B-[17.170 - <28.000]" ~ "[17.170 - <28.000]",
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "C-[28.000 - <45.400]" ~ "[28.000 - <45.400]",
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "D-[45.400 - >104.550]" ~ "[45.400 - >104.550]",
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "E-[NSPR - NSP]" ~ "c_Don't know or d_No answer",
      fa_fo_revenus_corr == "F-[MODULE SAUTÉ]" ~ "b_Module not complete"
    ),
    .after = fa_fo_revenus_corr
    ) %>% 
  select(-fa_fo_revenus_corr)



```

## Value labels

### Labels NAs

```{r}

rcd_tagged_na_dbl <- function(df, vars_dbl){
  
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
          {{vars_dbl}},
          ~ replace_when(
            .x,
            .x >= 0 ~ .x,
            .x == -1 ~ tagged_na("a"),
            .x == -2 ~ tagged_na("b"),
            .x == -8 ~ tagged_na("c"),
            .x == -9 ~ tagged_na("d")
          )
        )
      )
}

# Pas encore testée, je pense ne pas m'en servir pcq ça transformerait les 
# réponses libres en facteurs
rcd_tagged_na_txt <- function(df, vars_txt){
  
  df %>% 
    mutate(
      across(
          {{vars_txt}},
          ~ replace_when(
            .x,
            .x == "-1" ~ tagged_na("a"),
            .x == "-2" ~ tagged_na("b"),
            .x == "-8" ~ tagged_na("c"),
            .x == "-9" ~ tagged_na("d")
          )
        )
      )
}

rcd_levels_na <- function(df, var){
  
  df %>% 
    set_value_labels(
          {{var}} := c(
            "Not applicable" = tagged_na("a"),
            "Module not completed" = tagged_na("b"),
            "Don’t know" = tagged_na("c"),
            "No answer" = tagged_na("d")
          )
      )
}

```
